description:
Functional specifications / files: lib/zaq_web/live/bo/communication/channels_live.ex, channel_disable_policy.ex, Engine DisableChannelConnector/ConnectorCommand consumers, Engine/Channels API handlers and bridge logout wrappers. Confirmation invokes the shared disable operation. BO displays capability-derived destructive-disable information and results; it does not resolve adapter modules or hardcode WhatsApp logout. Audit and remove dedicated disable Action, :connector_logout and helpers only when replaced and unused. Preserve shared enable/archive functions, user authorization, selected config and revision context.
Tests to add before implementation: LiveView shared-toggle confirmation/cancel, successful disable, logout failure, stale confirmation, selected-profile Delete, unauthorized direct event, and non-logout adapter normal disable. Assert the shared path receives both confirmation and Delete requests.
Branches/paths validated: confirm/cancel, success/error, refresh/retry, current actor restrictions and alternate providers. Existing visible behavior should remain unchanged.
Mocking plan: existing adapter/provider fake at external boundary; retain real NodeRouter and Engine execution. No direct BO calls across service roles.
Documentation: update module docs, relevant service sections and finding #5 disposition in root review artifact if present. Read DESIGN.md and docs/bo-components.md before affected UI work.
Action reuse assessment: reuse main toggle/runtime/status/flash infrastructure and new shared disable implementation. Retain PR confirmation UI only as presentation. Remove duplicate dispatch wrappers after reference audit; do not remove unrelated enable Action merely because it was introduced in this PR.

Required policies: docs/agent-tools.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/services/channels.md and docs/services/engine.md. Read docs/services/system-config.md before touching credential boundaries. Recheck live main/branch and existing callers before implementation. Dependencies are sequential to avoid parallel overlapping lifecycle edits.

comments.text: User explicitly approved updating existing enable-after-logout assertions to observe shared disable sync then enable sync (async reply). Preserve all profile/QR/settings/auth assertions. Related obsolete disable route suite removed; preparation and archive behavior coverage migrated to shared route tests. Two-phase internal Engine canonical-read/persist commands carry no adapter knowledge.

BO confirmed disable and ordinary disable both invoke the same sync event. Confirmation is selected from exact-connector Channels logout_on_disable capability; provider label remains presentation copy. Removed DisableChannelConnector Action, disable_channel_connector/connector_logout/connector_prepare_disable handlers, ConnectorLifecycle.disable and redundant public logout wrappers. Existing enable behavior retained. Shared-sync test expectation changes explicitly approved by user.
